author: Marlon Chaviano
name: github-action
title: GitHub Action with TypeScript
description: A GitHub Action in TypeScript from the official template: typed inputs and outputs, tests with Jest and the bundle in dist/ ready to publish on the Marketplace.
instructions:
## How to work here

- The logic lives in `src/main.ts`; inputs and outputs are declared in `action.yml` and read with `core.getInput()` / `core.setOutput()`.
- Test locally with `npm run local-action` (it uses `.env` for the inputs) and with `npm test`.
- GitHub runs `dist/index.js`: after changing the code, run `npm run bundle` and commit `dist/`.
- Publish with a version tag (`v1`, `v1.0.0`) and a release.
